title: sizeof in function array parameter observes pointer size
summary: When the function parameter is declared as T a[N], the parameter type is adjusted to a pointer to T; sizeof a in the function takes the size of the pointer.
applies: C11; Offline memory diagnostics and object representation
detail: For the same array, use sizeof in the scope where it is declared to get the number of bytes of the complete object. See C11 §6.7.6.3.
boundary: Passing in a pointer to the entire array T (*)[N] is another declaration, sizeof *p preserves the array width.
relevance: Explain why the length in the log changes from tens of bytes to a pointer width after crossing a function boundary.
